I first moved to Berlin (the West) in 1979 and stayed for 6 years, gorgeous years. I loved it, but I wanted to move on. Milan, Paris ....
Some 30 years later I (re)moved to Berlin (the entire Berlin), and I love it again.
It feels like coming home, somehow.
So interesting and inspiring, so calm and slow, but definitely "berlinish".
As I continue to be abroad very often, I'd like to share my home with those who are curious to experience Berlin. Go out, discover and get as much as You can. Come home then and feel at home.
